description: This file contains utility functions for handling optional tensors and tensor options in the PyTorch codebase, including mechanisms to remove hacky wrappers for optional tensors and TensorOptions, and functions to check and update device consistency across tensors.

methods.name: check_and_update_common_device
methods.description: Checks and updates the common device for tensors, ensuring device consistency and handling optional tensors and tensor lists.

methods.name: common_device_check_failure
methods.description: Handles failure when device check fails, likely logging or throwing an error.
